title: Janus: Evidence-Before-Effect Sagas and Offline-Verifiable Provenance for Agentic LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.38266v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agentic large language models (LLMs) now move money through tools, yet the record of what they did is usually a trace their own process emits beside the effect. Janus puts the record on the effect path. A step's proposal, the verdict on it and any answer from a validator or a person are durable in a signed, hash-chained log before the step may run or its effect be released; with keys declared, each answer is signed by whoever gave or relayed it. Gates are pure functions of that log, and an auditor re-derives every verdict offline from the log and one public key. At the MCP edge the effect is held until then; through the SDK, which our model experiment uses, a cooperating client runs it only afterwards. translated_title: Janus：面向代理式大语言模型的“证据先于效应”Saga 与离线可验证溯源
translated_abstract: 代理式大语言模型如今通过工具转移资金，然而关于它们所做之事的记录，通常只是其自身进程在效应发生时附带产生的追踪信息。Janus 将记录置于效应路径之上：在一个步骤得以运行或其效应被释放之前，该步骤的提案、对其的裁决以及来自验证者或人工的任何回答，都会先持久化到一个经过签名、哈希链式相连的日志中；通过声明密钥，每个回答都由给出或转发它的人签名。门控逻辑是该日志的纯函数，审计者可以仅凭日志和一个公钥离线重新推导每一个裁决。在 MCP 边缘，效应会被扣留直至验证完成；而通过我们模型实验所使用的 SDK，协作客户端只在此之后才执行效应。我们在崩溃注入下评估了 Janus（进程内 144 次终止、经由守护进程 81 次终止），离线验证了一亿条事件的日志（254.5 秒），并用真实模型驱动一个贷款工作流，在相同的记录数据上以受治理与普通两种模式运行进行对比评估。
tldr: Janus 提出“证据先于效应”机制，在代理式 LLM 的步骤生效前，将其提案、裁决及验证者/人工回答写入签名哈希链日志，使审计者仅凭日志和一个公钥即可离线重新推导全部裁决。
en_tdlr: Janus enforces evidence-before-effect for agentic LLMs by durably recording each step's proposal, verdict, and validator/human answers in a signed, hash-chained log before effects are released, allowing auditors to re-derive every verdict offline from the log and a single public key.
